name: APEX Internet
summary: Canberra's favourite ISP (dialup + hosting); acquired ORAC 2001, renamed Apex Telecom ~Nov 2011, absorbed CyberOne customers Jun 2012, sold to NetSpeed Communications Jun 2012.

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture of apex.net.au Dec 1998.
Sold to NetSpeed Communications (June 2012); ultimate holding Velocity Internet.
